honest: Made for Kids Shorts ads cannot be assumed to hit $1,000,000. RPM is usually low. Automation builds a daily original 3D library. Revenue is views x RPM after YPP, plus later off-YouTube products.
publish_rule: Upload at most 1 unique Short per calendar day. Never dump the year. Never reuse a video.
ypp_kids: Apply on the KIDS channel only when YouTube says the account is eligible. Do not use gaming-channel login.

ladder.name: Machine on rails
ladder.you_do: Blender works. credentials/kids/client_secret.json exists. PC stays on overnight.

ladder.name: 30 days of one unique film
ladder.you_do: Watch YouTube Studio: average view duration, which topics kids finish.
ladder.factory: Keep --daily. Do not upload 30 videos in one night.

ladder.name: YouTube Partner Program
ladder.you_do: Turn on YPP on this kids channel. Read the real RPM. That number is the truth.
ladder.factory: Same daily unique Shorts. English. Made for Kids.

ladder.name: Scale quality, not copies
ladder.you_do: Swap better free 3D models into winners. Keep losers' topics out of the next year.
ladder.factory: Unique Blender + unique BGM + unique thumbnail every day.

ladder.name: Money beyond ads
ladder.you_do: Later: books, printables, school licenses OFF YouTube. Kids videos cannot ask for comments, emails, or merch clicks.
ladder.factory: Not automated. Do not mix the gaming brand here.

ads_math_note: If kids Shorts RPM is $0.20 per 1000 views, $1,000,000 needs about 5 billion views. If RPM is $1, it still needs about 1 billion views. Treat $1M as a multi-year brand goal, not a first-year ads payout.
